proposals.evidence: Turner places the nasal ṭhaṇḍ-/thaṇḍ- cold family under stabdha, with explicit Nepali, Bengali, Oriya, Bhojpuri, Awadhi, Gujarati and Marathi comparanda and proposed Dravidian influence on the nasal formation. This is a qualified comparative-family link, not a claim of unmodified sound-law descent or exclusion of regional contact; ordinary dental/retroflex transcription and final agreement are preserved.
